scope: read-only discovery of frozen source, declared trials and latest attempts

baseline.description: measured fixed baseline: legacy status plus separate attempt ledger lookup; reconstructed, not historical pre-rollout capture

corpus.scope_limit: deterministic synthetic fixtures, not human/agent deployment outcomes

limitations: API-call counts describe named Python API steps, not LLM calls or tokens.
The baseline is a measured reconstruction of the legacy two-call path, not a contemporaneous pre-rollout capture.
Both workflows are designed to avoid market-data reads; zero reads is not a claimed optimization.
Latency varies with CPU load, filesystem cache, unrelated VPS load, tmux visibility and attempt count.
Nine correlated warm samples do not support a significance claim; first-call values are not process-cold.
No measured cost or quality improvement outside this fixed task is implied.
Time-to-action is response latency, not human or agent decision time.
